disclaimer: SYNTHETIC DATA — Northwind Digital portfolio demo only. Workato-shaped orchestration pattern; not a live Workato workspace or licensed connector.
label: Workato-shaped
product_note: Illustrates an iPaaS-style exception recipe. No Workato SDK, tenant, or customer credentials.

recipe.name: CRM Closed Won → ERP commercial integrity exception

trigger.description: Fires when opportunity stage moves to Closed Won, or on nightly CRM↔ERP amount reconcile for open commits.

steps.name: Extract CRM opportunity + contract
steps.detail: Read Closed Won opportunity OPP-GE-2026-0422 and signed contract: 8 MW / $4.8M.

steps.name: Fetch ERP sales order + PO
steps.detail: Pull SO-10491 and PO-10491 for project GE-2026-0422: 5 MW / $3.2M (Phase 1 only).

steps.name: Compute commercial gap
steps.detail: Gap = CRM $4.8M − ERP $3.2M → $1.6M / 3 MW expansion not on SO/PO.

steps.name: Evaluate integrity policy
steps.detail: |gap| > $0 and require_so_po_match_before_buy → open exception; do not auto-issue buy.

steps.name: Upsert Deal Record exception
steps.detail: Create/update exception on GE-2026-0422: CRM↔ERP amount + MW conflict; expansion line blocked.

steps.name: Notify RevOps + procurement
steps.detail: Alert deal owner and procurement: Closed Won ≠ authority to buy until SO/PO match.

steps.name: Write recipe audit log
steps.detail: Log recipe_id, run_id, inputs (opp/SO/PO ids), gap amounts, and outcome — same audit discipline as Close Agent tool calls.

outcome.summary: Recipe completed: $1.6M / 3 MW gap opened on Deal Record; further PO blocked until ERP catches up.

failure_scenario.name: Same recipe — ERP connector failure path
failure_scenario.description: When ERP read fails, the recipe does not invent a match. It dead-letters to a human queue with the audit trail intact.

outcome.summary: ERP fetch failed — run sent to human queue; no silent CRM overwrite; buy remains blocked until reconcile.

close_agent_parallel.pattern: Same integration spine: extract → transform → policy decide → write exception/audit → human gate on failure.
close_agent_parallel.close_use: Trial balance and subledger land via Workato-shaped load/sync before the Close Agent drafts flux; sync failures never invent drivers.
